reason: Losing that $9,000 kitchen job stung, and 249 $ a month is nothing next to one job. But I'm not handing my business line and my customers' addresses to a one-man setup I've never heard of, and paying 2,000 $ up front, when nothing here says where the call data goes or who can see it.
objection: Is my customers' data private and kept in Québec under Law 25, and what happens to my line if this founder gets sick or disappears? On top of that, the job I lost was a quote that sat unanswered, so I'm not sure a phone receptionist would even have caught it, and it only works with Google Calendar.
would_change_my_mind: Calling the demo line in French and English and having it sound like a real Montréal receptionist in both, plus a written privacy policy saying where the data is stored, and two or three local trade owners I can call who have used it for months.
